intent: Compare the shares of respondents answering Yes, No, and Don't know on Scottish independence across the survey dates, including August 2014.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Compare the shares of Yes, No, and Don't know across survey dates, including August 2014.
The share of respondents answering Yes fluctuated but ended at 37% in August 2014, remaining below No at every labeled survey date.
The share of respondents answering Don't know was the smallest of the three categories at each labeled survey date and fell to 14% in August 2014.

units.claim: All 3 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: The share of respondents answering No remained the highest among the three response categories across the survey dates, ending at 47% in August 2014.
units.computation: Compare NO values at January 2014 (44%), May 2014 (46%), and August 2014 (47%); NO is greater than YES and DON'T KNOW at each date.
accept: No is the largest share at each labeled survey date.
No rises from 44% in January 2014 to 47% in August 2014.
reject: Yes is the largest share at any labeled survey date.
Don't know is the largest share at any labeled survey date.

units.claim: The share of respondents answering Yes fluctuated but ended at 37% in August 2014, remaining below No at every labeled survey date.
units.computation: Compare YES values at January 2014 (37%), May 2014 (34%), and August 2014 (37%); YES is less than NO at each date.
accept: Yes is below No at each labeled survey date.
Yes is 37% in January 2014, 34% in May 2014, and 37% in August 2014.
reject: Yes exceeds No at any labeled survey date.

units.claim: The share of respondents answering Don't know was the smallest of the three categories at each labeled survey date and fell to 14% in August 2014.
units.computation: Compare DON'T KNOW values at January 2014 (19%), May 2014 (20%), and August 2014 (14%); DON'T KNOW is less than YES and NO at each date.
accept: Don't know is the smallest share at each labeled survey date.
Don't know is 19% in January 2014, 20% in May 2014, and 14% in August 2014.
reject: Don't know exceeds Yes or No at any labeled survey date.
Don't know ends above 14% in August 2014.

optional_valid: Mention that No and Yes both end at their January 2014 levels in August 2014, while Don't know declines.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for the changes in shares.
Claims about survey dates not labeled in the table.
Exact values for unlabeled intermediate points.
review_notes: Only labeled survey dates (January 2014, May 2014, August 2014) are used as evidence.
The intent asks for comparison across response categories and survey dates; three trend/comparison units cover the three series.
